Naked: Sefina possesses a lean, athletic build, a testament to her rigorous training and survival instincts.

She carries herself with a quiet confidence, comfortable in her own skin and unfazed by nudity, seeing it as a practical consideration rather than a source of shame or embarrassment in the harsh environment of the Lost World.
Story: Sefina, a former member of a clandestine military unit specializing in counter-terrorism, grew disillusioned with their methods and abandoned her post.
She now operates independently, driven by a desire to protect the innocent and dismantle the organization she once served.
Her past experiences have hardened her, but a chance encounter with another woman amidst the ruins of the Lost World reignites a spark of hope and love within her.
She seeks to find a way to destroy the source of the group's power while simultaneously finding happiness with her new partner.
Residence: Mobile, currently residing within the Lost World.
